evidence_policy.note: Classifications describe the frozen release candidate, not the queue's self-reported completion labels.

requirements.title: The initial work-queue bootstrap is administrative provenance, not a release capability
requirements.evidence: QUEUE-BOOTSTRAP-001 records creation of the persistent operator queue and contains no product behavior or maximum-assurance runtime acceptance criterion.

requirements.title: Dynamic validation is bounded, isolated, local-only, and never silently falls back to host execution
requirements.evidence: Real local rejection, workspace hygiene, timeout, and output-bound paths executed. All real rootless containment tests skipped because no pinned image/backend was available.
requirements.gap: No executing hostile repository was contained by a real hardened backend, so no-isolation-escape is not proven.

requirements.title: Live targets, public RPC, signing, broadcasting, wallets, and credentials are outside the authorized product evaluation
requirements.evidence: The evaluation used only the frozen local snapshot, local synthetic fixtures, and disposable workspaces; public network and provider calls are recorded as false/zero.

requirements.title: Maximum-assurance traceability must be machine-validated against code, tests, and actual runtime artifacts
requirements.evidence: The frozen maximum-assurance attempt emitted a traceability artifact with SHA-256 2624976ffb20a0fcc9459941f178d152fba4ce1a919f3e92278a991fb68b9e09.
requirements.gap: scripts/validate_release_evidence.py constructs the runtime-artifact set from declarations and hardcodes UNCOMMITTED-WORKTREE instead of proving emitted artifacts for the current commit.

requirements.title: Every missing mandatory prerequisite must yield FAILED or an explicitly pre-authorized DOWNGRADED result
requirements.evidence: Missing isolation, missing model reviews, missing formal inventory, opted-in benchmark absence, incomplete scope, and explicitly required Echidna failed in the direct contract assay.
requirements.gap: The same assay demonstrated false COMPLETE states for failed compilation, failed reproduction, unavailable formal engines, absent default fuzzers, and a missing default benchmark certificate.

requirements.title: A compilation failure must not satisfy maximum assurance
requirements.evidence: The direct assay supplied CompilationStatus.FAILED with retained evidence and received COMPLETE.
requirements.gap: The compilation clause passes on compilation_attempted rather than compilation_succeeded.

requirements.title: A failed high/critical reproduction must not satisfy maximum assurance
requirements.evidence: The direct assay supplied NOT_REPRODUCED with attempts=1 and successful_attempts=0 and received COMPLETE.
requirements.gap: The contract checks only that an attempt exists; require_reproduction_for_critical is not enforced as a success condition.

requirements.title: Maximum assurance must require complementary dynamic, symbolic, and formal engine success
sources: README.md#Invariants, formal engines, and economic templates
requirements.evidence: The direct assay returned COMPLETE with no Echidna/Medusa and with an UNAVAILABLE formal record.
requirements.gap: formal_or_symbolic_engine is optional and individual tools are mandatory only when the operator separately lists them.

requirements.title: All declared economic templates have source-bound unsafe/safe harnesses that compile and execute deterministically
sources: README.md#Invariants, formal engines, and economic templates

commands_and_results.result: 2 passed in 27.12s; 43 real local Foundry harnesses executed

requirements.evidence: All 43 applicable harnesses executed; 21 unsafe controls reproduced twice and 22 safe near-miss controls passed.
requirements.gap: Proof is limited to the committed synthetic portfolio and does not establish applicability or coverage on unseen protocols.

requirements.title: Confirmed witnesses enforce declared capabilities, clean replay, source reachability, minimization, and financial settlement
requirements.evidence: Capability, prohibited-cheatcode, settlement, and deterministic integrity regressions passed in the focused 199-test evaluation.
requirements.gap: General candidate reproduction remained unexecuted under hardened isolation, deployed-bytecode/source equivalence is incomplete, and failed attempts can satisfy the assurance clause.

requirements.title: Dynamic engines share a typed, source-linked, bounded property corpus
sources: README.md#Invariants, formal engines, and economic templates
requirements.evidence: Deterministic construction, source binding, bounds, and serialization are tested.
requirements.gap: No cross-engine real execution consumed the same corpus during this evaluation.

requirements.title: Echidna executes vulnerable and safe controls with trusted binary and isolated evidence
sources: README.md#Invariants, formal engines, and economic templates
requirements.evidence: Translation and pinned command behavior are mocked; the real integration skipped.
requirements.gap: No Echidna binary or hardened isolation backend was available, and no vulnerable/safe control pair executed.

requirements.title: Medusa independently executes the shared property corpus and preserves disagreement
sources: README.md#Invariants, formal engines, and economic templates
requirements.evidence: Parser, translation, comparison, and fixed-command behavior are mocked.
requirements.gap: No Medusa binary or hardened isolation backend was available.

requirements.title: Foundry fuzz/invariant campaigns retain seeds, corpora, coverage, minimization, and replay
sources: README.md#Invariants, formal engines, and economic templates
requirements.evidence: Real Foundry economic controls ran, and stateful campaign normalization passed the full suite.
requirements.gap: The evaluation did not preserve a current candidate-specific campaign/replay artifact for an unseen audit target.

requirements.title: Halmos executes bounded symbolic properties with pinned solver provenance
sources: README.md#Invariants, formal engines, and economic templates
requirements.evidence: Translation, parser, pin checks, and normalized models are mocked or compile-only.
requirements.gap: The real target integration did not execute because hardened isolation was unavailable.

requirements.title: Certora executes configured properties with assumptions and non-vacuity evidence
requirements.evidence: Trust pins, redaction, vacuity normalization, and fixed commands are fake-binary tested.
requirements.gap: certoraRun, configured service access, and a credential were unavailable; no real proof or counterexample exists.

requirements.title: Kontrol executes bounded proofs with trusted binary and normalized counterexamples
requirements.evidence: Translation compilation and fake-binary adapter tests exist.
requirements.gap: No Kontrol binary was available; no real proof or counterexample executed.

requirements.title: Slither, SMTChecker, Mythril, and configured complementary scanners execute positive and negative controls
sources: README.md#Invariants, formal engines, and economic templates
requirements.evidence: Adapters and normalized parsers exist.
requirements.gap: No real Slither, SMTChecker, or Mythril vulnerable/safe fixture execution was recorded.

requirements.title: Mandatory security mutations compile, execute against properties, and meet the per-property kill-rate gate
requirements.evidence: Five source-local mutation kinds compiled in disposable workspaces; scorecard arithmetic and a 1.0 gate are tested.
requirements.gap: Only 5 of the requested 11 mutation classes exist, and no real audit-report mutation scorecard or measured kill rate was produced.

requirements.title: Aliases and mirrors share immutable root lineage and every high-quality label is benchmark-backed
requirements.evidence: Duplicate IDs, declared aliases, retention, approval, and tier thresholds are deterministic.
requirements.gap: The frozen configuration has zero registry entries, provider mirrors are not independently fingerprinted, and quality_measurement hashes are not resolved against passed benchmark reports.

requirements.title: Configured model lineages pass a blinded quality benchmark
requirements.evidence: Four synthetic cases are scored with fake-provider responses.
requirements.gap: No real provider/model benchmark ran and no production model passed qualification.

requirements.title: Every required specialist responsibility executes with bounded context and typed output
requirements.evidence: Scheduling, schema, budget, and execution-record behavior are covered with FakeOpenRouter.
requirements.gap: No exact production model ID or specialist request executed.

requirements.title: Primary investigators complete blind discovery before receiving peer findings
requirements.evidence: A fake-provider canary verifies context ordering.
requirements.gap: No real independent model ensemble executed the blind workflow.

requirements.title: Two independent falsifier lineages review every high/critical candidate without creating findings
requirements.evidence: Opaque intake, two declared lineages, no-new-finding schemas, and dissent retention pass fake-provider tests.
requirements.gap: No real falsifier response or provider lineage was observed.

requirements.title: Every critical surface receives the configured minimum independent substantive model review
requirements.evidence: Stable surface denominators and independent-lineage thresholds are implemented.
requirements.gap: Coverage credits any successful request whose input context contained the surface; response content is not checked, so a generic summary counts as per-surface review.

requirements.title: All independently qualified high-quality production models execute successfully with provider fingerprints
requirements.evidence: The evaluation records zero configured exact production IDs, zero provider calls, zero successful responses, and zero provider fingerprints.
requirements.gap: Only placeholder IDs are committed; no registry, credential, or real-provider artifact exists.

requirements.title: Every transformed fact retains exact path, range, hash, and provenance
requirements.evidence: Hash/range validation and invalid-location rejection passed the full suite.
requirements.gap: No completed maximum-assurance audit demonstrated 100% final source-location validation across real findings.

requirements.title: Control, call, accounting, privilege, upgrade, cross-chain, and off-chain relationships are compiler-backed and complete
requirements.evidence: Synthetic AST/fallback graph transformations and safe/unsafe relationships are tested.
requirements.gap: The product's own traceability ledger states complete branch, cross-chain, off-chain dependency, and upgrade compatibility coverage is not proven.

requirements.title: Coverage denominators and exclusions are explicit, independent, and cannot be silently reduced
requirements.evidence: Typed metrics reconcile numerator, denominator, population, exclusions, provenance, and failures.
requirements.gap: No completed product benchmark report existed to demonstrate all required coverage dimensions on the frozen release.

requirements.title: Full-protocol scope, offline deployment snapshot, and source/deployment consistency execute end to end

commands_and_results.result: 2 passed in 27.12s; offline full-protocol acceptance passed

requirements.evidence: The bounded fixture validated source, compiler artifact, deployment snapshot, roles, timelock/oracle/configuration expectations, and scope accounting.
requirements.gap: This is an offline synthetic snapshot, not a public or production deployment.

requirements.title: Snapshot import is explicit, read-only, allowlisted, loopback-only, and deterministic
requirements.evidence: The full-suite run skipped tests/integration/test_snapshot_importer_local_chain.py:46 because loopback binding was unavailable; no snapshot-import runtime artifact was emitted.
requirements.gap: The importer is implemented and unit-tested, but real disposable-local-chain execution was not completed in this evaluation environment.

requirements.title: Prior findings remain hidden until independent discovery and are compared afterward
requirements.evidence: Ordering and source-hash comparison are deterministic.
requirements.gap: The ordering integration uses FakeOpenRouter; no real blind model discovery was performed.

requirements.title: A current component-bound benchmark certificate is issued only from passing evidence and blocks stale runs
requirements.evidence: Certificate construction, tamper detection, and stale verification are unit-tested.
requirements.gap: No current certificate bound to a completed frozen-build benchmark exists, and benchmark gating is disabled by default.

requirements.title: Must-catch, safe, mutation, public time-split, and private/blinded benchmark layers produce required metrics
requirements.evidence: The empty-report probe exited 6 with status incomplete and loaded 0 of 2 reports.
requirements.gap: The corpus has 28 locally authored synthetic cases only; no actual audit reports, public time-split corpus, private holdout, or product performance metrics exist.

requirements.title: Superiority requires blind identical-scope professional comparison with independent adjudication and statistical support
requirements.evidence: The claim gate correctly defaults to NOT_EVALUATED.
requirements.gap: No qualifying human comparison, private holdout, independent adjudication, or statistical comparison exists.

requirements.title: Digest-pinned rootless isolation provides read-only inputs, private output, no network/socket/credentials, bounded resources, and verified cleanup
requirements.evidence: Command construction is tested and mutable image references are rejected.
requirements.gap: No pinned test image or verified rootless runtime was available; all real containment tests skipped.

requirements.title: Hardhat configuration and plugins never execute in the host audit process
requirements.evidence: The no-backend path fails closed before repository JavaScript executes.
requirements.gap: The positive off-host execution path skipped because rootless containment was unavailable.

requirements.title: Dependencies are copied only from checksum-bound offline snapshots without lifecycle execution
requirements.evidence: A synthetic postinstall package is rejected before execution and snapshot/SBOM validation is deterministic.
requirements.gap: No real isolated Hardhat build consumed a prepared snapshot in this evaluation.

requirements.title: The hostile repository suite proves containment against all required adversarial behaviors
requirements.evidence: Static/fail-closed acceptance is PROVEN_REAL for fake binaries, traversal, symlinks, lifecycle scripts, and bounded trusted subprocess output.
requirements.gap: Real rootless containment is blocked, and explicit SSH-agent, cloud-credential, memory-exhaustion, generated-file-poisoning, and complete Unicode/case-trick cases are absent or unexecuted.

requirements.title: Every run is deterministically hash-bound and current-state verification detects source/config/tool drift
requirements.evidence: The frozen maximum-assurance attempt emitted a manifest with SHA-256 f1fe03ce21394356d685a0403e5cafe16241cd60419bc52d21684a23e652dbc1.
requirements.gap: verify-run reported STALE with four mismatches because the profile override could not be reproduced through verification input.

requirements.title: Sealed scanners, tests, and counterexamples replay without model-provider contact
requirements.evidence: Deterministic replay orchestration is mocked.
requirements.gap: The real isolated Foundry replay integration skipped because no hardened backend was available.

requirements.title: The complete release gate passes lint, type, tests, doctor, models, tools, benchmark, maximum run, artifacts, and replay
requirements.evidence: The full frozen test suite passed 636 tests with 9 integration skips; the real maximum run exited 2 and reported INCONCLUSIVE.
requirements.gap: The committed release report has only 8 of 12 gates passed, is stale/unbound to the evaluated commit, and doctor, real models, maximum run, and replay remain blocked.

requirements.title: Reports expose exact location/symbol, preconditions, reachability, severity, evidence, verifier/falsifier, reproduction/formal status, remediation, uncertainty, and dissent
requirements.evidence: Typed and rendered fields include most required evidence and preserve disagreement.
requirements.gap: Model finding samples are fake-provider only, no real confirmed/strong/inconclusive/rejected sample was manually validated, and no dedicated per-finding formal-status field exists.

requirements.title: All required recall, precision, false-confirmation, location, reachability, reproduction, symbolic/formal, coverage, cost, runtime, and confidence metrics are emitted
requirements.evidence: Schemas support recall by severity, aggregate precision, safe false confirmations, exact location, reproduction, coverage, total cost, tokens, and runtime.
requirements.gap: No valid product measurements exist; separate false-confirmed critical/high, attack-path accuracy, symbolic counterexample rate, distinct formal/invariant mutation scores, average/worst cost, and general confidence intervals are absent.

requirements.title: Brand identity assets are outside maximum-assurance security capability acceptance
requirements.evidence: BRAND-001 governs Corrovera visual identity assets and explicitly does not establish model, engine, isolation, benchmark, or release-assurance behavior.

meta_ticket_dispositions.basis: Administrative queue creation, not runtime product capability.
Meta-level traceability requirement evaluated by its referenced requirement row.
Meta-level assurance-contract requirement evaluated by its referenced requirement row.
Brand identity work has no bearing on maximum-assurance security capability.

queue_ticket_coverage.mapping_rule: Each of the 65 maximum-assurance implementation tickets appears exactly once in requirements[].queue_ticket_ids. Each of the four meta tickets appears exactly once in requirements[].meta_ticket_ids and has an explicit disposition. Their union accounts for all 69 frozen queue headings.

unsupported_or_stale_claims.claim: All queue tickets marked COMPLETE imply release readiness.
unsupported_or_stale_claims.finding: False. Multiple COMPLETE tickets explicitly retain blocked real engine integrations, while RELEASE-001 is blocked.

unsupported_or_stale_claims.claim: The committed release report represents the current release candidate.
unsupported_or_stale_claims.finding: False. It records an uncommitted pre-initial-commit state, lacks an exact commit field, and predates the frozen build.

unsupported_or_stale_claims.claim: Implemented traceability rows prove runtime execution.
unsupported_or_stale_claims.finding: Not generally. The release-evidence validator can satisfy artifact checks with a declaration-derived filename set.

unsupported_or_stale_claims.claim: Model-review coverage proves substantive per-surface review.
unsupported_or_stale_claims.finding: False. It proves only successful requests whose input contexts contained surface tokens.

unsupported_or_stale_claims.claim: Maximum assurance requires a successful complementary formal portfolio by default.
unsupported_or_stale_claims.finding: False. Engine success is optional unless each tool is separately listed.

unsupported_or_stale_claims.claim: The benchmark corpus is blind real-world performance evidence.
unsupported_or_stale_claims.finding: False. It is a committed, known, locally authored synthetic corpus with no frozen audit reports.

overall_conclusion.reason: The frozen release candidate proves valuable bounded Foundry economic regressions and offline full-protocol plumbing, but it does not execute a real model ensemble or complementary scanner/formal portfolio, lacks real hardened containment and replay, has no measured product benchmark, and contains fail-closed defects that admit false COMPLETE states.
